remarks: Charming mid city home with abundant natural light, experience the perfect blend of comfort and style in this inviting peaceful home. The open floor plan effortlessly connects the main living spaces, enhanced by skylights in the family and dining rooms that invite the outdoors in. Enjoy picturesque views from the large bay window and sliders leading to a spacious deck and patio, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. The eat-in kitchen features elegant granite countertops and an island, overlooking a beautifully landscaped backyard. The main level includes two generous bedrooms, a full bath, and ample closet space for all your storage needs. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts its own full bath, accompanied by a versatile den that can easily serve as a fourth bedroom or nursery. The lower level is partially finished, offering additional potential. Conveniently located near a variety of restaurants, Ridgeway shopping center, Scalzi Park with its playground, bocce courts, baseball fields, tennis courts, as well as nearby hospital and a golf course, this home provides unmatched accessibility to local amenities. This property is available furnished (optional) and requires impeccable credit. Tenants are responsible for all utilities and must provide two months' security, a credit report, liability insurance, and cover landscaping and snow removal. Don't miss this opportunity to make this charming home yours!
